Strong and em tags use underscore symbol instead of asterisk

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"strong_em_symbol\":\"_\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p><strong>bold</strong> and <em>italic</em></p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
```
